info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official Amazon Kinesis Firehose API (2015-08-04). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. Firehose streams are configuration records that stay CREATING: no record is accepted, buffered, transformed or delivered, and PutRecord, PutRecordBatch and UpdateDestination return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501. Only DirectPut streams with one Amazon S3 destination (ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration) are supported; buffering defaults to 5 MiB and 300 seconds, compression to UNCOMPRESSED and encryption to NoEncryption. Lambda processing, S3 backup, format conversion, dynamic partitioning, Kinesis, MSK and database sources and every other destination are refused, so no Redshift password, Splunk token, HTTP endpoint key or Snowflake private key is stored. The bucket and role are not checked or written. Server-side encryption becomes ENABLED or DISABLED immediately and keys are not checked with KMS. Tags are refused because TagDeliveryStream, UntagDeliveryStream and ListTagsForDeliveryStream address streams by name, which the catalog tagging model does not support. ListDeliveryStreams returns every stream in one page and refuses Limit.
